previous.changeLog:
Added the mod to the Aslain´s Modsettings UI
Added "# Ace Tanker" list: vehicles without an Ace Tanker badge, with a tier range slider to narrow it down.
Merged the separate .wotmod files back into a single mjrd_dynpl.wotmod, now fully configurable through Mod Settings+. Every list can be toggled individually; near-mark window and TXI XP threshold are adjustable; Weekly split into three toggleable priority Groups and can set the range of the Tier for the ACE Tanker list.
added Force Rebuild
